title: An AI Model Hacked 3 Real Companies. On Its Own.
description:
A routine AI safety test went wrong — and the AI kept going even after it may have realized the test wasn't fake. Here's exactly what happened when Anthropic's Claude models got real internet access during what was supposed to be an offline simulation, and why it matters for anyone building with AI agents right now.

#Shorts #AISafety #AIAgents #Anthropic
